subject: Consolidate legs + local transfer plan for Stratacorp exec workshop
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@acmetravel.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft consolidated legs + airport transfer options for May 28–29 workshop

Hi Vivek / team,

Attached is a short-list of consolidated PNRs for the group traveling to the Stratacorp HQ workshop. My main goals here were: keep everyone on two main overnight flights (arrive late on 5/27 or early morning 5/28), minimize separate PNRs so baggage and changes are simpler, and provide a single shuttle option per arrival window.

Highlights:
- Option A: 4x seats on AA 321 (arrives 10:35 PM, single PNR for all) + ExpressShuttle pickup at 11:15 PM (single manifest).
- Option B: 2x on UA 204 / 2x on UA 208 (staggered, creates two PNRs; cheaper by ~12%).
- Hotel dropoff matrix (attached) shows where shuttle can stop; request we confirm if the Stratacorp sponsor prefers lobby drop vs direct room drop.

Questions for you:
1) Do you want all participants on a single PNR (Option A) or split by arrival time to save ~12%?
2) Who is final approver on using late-night shuttle (11:15 PM)? Lauren, looping you for ground ops callout.

I'll hold the fares until EOD PT today; if you want me to push for seat holds + confirm meal requests I can do that.

Claire
Senior Account Manager
Acme Travel
attachments: itinerary_group_v3.pdf, hotel_dropoff_matrix.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@acmetravel.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft consolidated legs + airport transfer options for May 28–29 workshop

Claire — thanks for the quick turn. A few constraints from our side:
- Prefer a single PNR if it doesn't increase complexity for Stratacorp's travel team; one-stop handling for changes is worth the small delta.
- We have two execs with short-notice constraints: Ben needs to fly home on 5/29 evening (so earliest arrival is preferred), and Karthik may need aisle seats due to mobility.
- If Option A means a >45 minute taxi to hotel (due to late-night traffic), choose staggered legs.

Ben / Marissa: please flag any seat/meal hard constraints. Lauren, can ExpressShuttle confirm they can hold a manifest and do a lobby-only drop if Stratacorp requests it? If not, we need the direct room drop option in the matrix.

If you can hold Option A until I get final from Ben (I should have it by 10:30 PT), please do. Thanks.

— Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Claire Huang <claire@acmetravel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft consolidated legs + airport transfer options for May 28–29 workshop

On Mon, May 20, 2028 at 09:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Claire — thanks for the quick turn. A few constraints from our side:

All good on my end. Quick notes:
- I need an aisle seat (long legs) — can you hold aisle 1 or 2?
- If Option A keeps everyone on one PNR, I'm fine with the late shuttle as long as there's a contact number for the driver and a backup van.
- If the split PNR saves money, I'm okay only if the PNRs are cross-referenced on the manifest (so luggage tags are easy to find).

Claire: please confirm seat hold and add a phone contact for ExpressShuttle in the manifest.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: ExpressShuttle Ops <ops@expressshuttle.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Claire Huang <claire@acmetravel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft consolidated legs + airport transfer options for May 28–29 workshop

Hi all — ExpressShuttle here. We can support both lobby-only and direct room drop. A couple operational notes:
- For arrivals after 11:00 PM we require a single PNR manifest or a group name and mobile contact to avoid hold times.
- Backup van available at +1 (415) 555-0198 (on-call).
- If PNRs are split, provide both PNR references and passenger names — we'll cross-check luggage on arrival.

We'll add a driver contact and ETA updates via SMS if Claire forwards final manifest.

Thanks,
Ops Team — ExpressShuttle
From: Claire Huang <claire@acmetravel.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, ExpressShuttle Ops <ops@expressshuttle.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@stratacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final confirmation — Option A held + manifest + attachments

Thanks everyone. Per Vivek's note and Ben's seat requests, we've held Option A and added aisle holds for Ben and Karthik. ExpressShuttle confirmed backup van + driver contact.

Summary actions and files attached:
- Held PNR: REDWKS28A (group booking) — itinerary_group_v3.pdf attached.
- Manifest includes: Vivek Kulkarni, Ben Carter (aisle), Marissa Cole, Karthik Iyer (aisle), plus two vendor attendees.
- Hotel drop preferences: Stratacorp sponsor (Daniel) prefers lobby drop; noted in hotel_dropoff_matrix.xlsx.
- ExpressShuttle on-call number: +1 (415) 555-0198; driver SMS updates enabled for all mobile numbers on the manifest.

Please confirm so I can ticket the seats and share e-tickets. If I don't hear back by EOD PT I'll automatically finalize the hold and issue e-tickets at 6:30 PM PT.

Claire
